script: A supernova is the explosion of a dying star. For a few weeks, one can outshine an entire galaxy of billions of stars. Many elements in your body were spread through space by explosions like these. Astronomers spot many supernovas in other galaxies every year. The last one seen in our own galaxy was in 1604.
